examples.title: Rainbow target
examples.description: Six coloured rings and a white crosshair, drawn with HC-BASIC's CIRCLE and LINE on the 320 by 256 screen.

examples.title: Times table
examples.description: Type a number and the KC prints its ten-times table; type 0 to stop.

examples.title: Stop the dot
examples.description: A dot races along the screen towards a caret marker; press any key to stop it, read how far off you were, then replay or press N to quit.
